name: Bloodsoaked Ruins
effectTemplate: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color> for 6s. They will also regain <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color> Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
